description: This file contains Go source code defining error handling utilities, including error aggregation, filtering, flattening, and error matching, for the Kubernetes project.

classes.name: aggregate
classes.description: Private type implementing the Aggregate interface, representing a collection of errors.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the aggregate errors.

methods.name: Is
methods.description: Checks if the aggregate contains an error matching the target.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Helper method to traverse errors in the aggregate, applying a function.

methods.name: Errors
methods.description: Returns the list of errors contained in the aggregate.
